sourceTitle: Southwestern Turkey Sliders With Chipotle Mayo
sourceText:
Southwestern Turkey Sliders With Chipotle Mayo
By: Anne Marie
Published: Wednesday, July 21, 2010 - 3:28pm

Ingredients




3 pounds ground turkey
2 poblano peppers, diced
1 small onion, minced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup cilantro, rough chopped
1 teaspoon cumin
1 teaspoon chipotle chili powder
Chipotle Mayo
2 teaspoons chipotle chili powder
1 teaspoon adobo sauce (from canned chipotles in adobo)
3 tablespoons Canola mayo
16 smalls whole wheat rolls (sometimes called dollar rolls)

Preparation

1 Mix turkey with peppers, onion, garlic, cilantro, cumin and 1 tsp. chili powder and form into 16 small burgers.  Cook over medium heat in a non-stick frying pan in batches until cooked through (about 6 minutes per side). 2 Mix remaining chili powder, adobo sauce and mayo in small bowl. 3 Spread chipotle mayo on roll, add burger and serve.
